accepted_output.selection_rationale: Prioritized major geopolitical escalations (US-Iran conflict, NATO/Ukraine developments), critical macroeconomic updates (IMF global forecasts, RBNZ rate hike), and significant tech/business moves (OpenAI GPT-5.6 launch, Apple-Broadcom deal, Amazon's massive debt sale). Merged related clusters across partitions to provide comprehensive, high-evidence narratives while filtering out noise and low-impact social media chatter.
